body:
Thanks, that looks close to what I want and with these couple changes (using a clearAll widget with excludeItems prop) I think should work as I want:
https://codesandbox.io/s/6xno2wyo93

But unfortunately the [algoliasearch wordpress plugin](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-wordpress) is packaging version 1.11.15 of instantsearch, where transformItems does not yet exist.

I will experiment with loading the latest instantsearch in its place and see what happens.
